steps.description: @assertion the startup "Welcome to VS Code" sign-in overlay is visible and its Close button is available.
Click the Close button on the startup Welcome sign-in overlay.
@assertion the startup sign-in overlay is no longer visible and the VS Code workbench is ready.
Press the F1 key to open the Command Palette in Visual Studio Code.
@assertion the Visual Studio Code Command Palette is visible with a > character in its input box and is ready to accept a command search.

parameters.text: Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit: Focus on Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit View

steps.description: Type the resolved command title into the active Command Palette.

@assertion the Command Palette input box reads >Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit: Focus on Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit View and the highlighted command listed under it is titled Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit: Focus on Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit View.
Press Enter to execute the selected Command Palette command.
@assertion the Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit view is open in the side bar and an editor tab labeled Welcome showing the Build a Declarative Agent walkthrough is open in the editor area.
@assertion the editor tab labeled Welcome showing the Build a Declarative Agent walkthrough is the active editor tab in the Visual Studio Code editor area.
Press Ctrl+W to close the Welcome editor tab.
@assertion no editor tab is open in the Visual Studio Code editor area.
Press the F1 key to open the Command Palette in Visual Studio Code.
@assertion the Visual Studio Code Command Palette is visible with a > character in its input box and is ready to accept a command search.
Type the resolved command title into the active Command Palette.
@assertion the Command Palette input box reads >Microsoft 365 Agents: Create New Agent/App and the highlighted command listed under it is titled Microsoft 365 Agents: Create New Agent/App.
Press Enter to execute the selected Command Palette command.
@assertion the active prompt titled New Project is visible.
@assertion the prompt titled New Project has finished loading and lists at least one selectable option.
Type the resolved option label Declarative Agent into the active single-select prompt.
@assertion the option Declarative Agent is visible and selectable in the filtered single-select prompt.
Press Enter to confirm the filtered single-select option.
@assertion the active prompt titled Create Declarative Agent is visible.
@assertion the prompt titled Create Declarative Agent has finished loading and lists at least one selectable option.
Type the resolved option label No Action into the active single-select prompt.
@assertion the option No Action is visible and selectable in the filtered single-select prompt.
Press Enter to confirm the filtered single-select option.
@assertion the active prompt titled Workspace Folder is visible and the option Default folder is focused.
Press Enter to confirm the Default folder option.
@assertion the active prompt titled Application Name is visible.
Type the authored value into the active text prompt.
Press Enter to submit the accepted text input.
@assertion the Preview README.md editor tab is open in Visual Studio Code.

=== Generated Script ===
Language: bash

```bash
set -euo pipefail
PROJECT_DIR="/home/vscode/AgentsToolkitProjects/${{var:app_name}}" ASSERTIONS_B64="" python3 - <<'PY'
import base64
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path

project = Path(os.environ["PROJECT_DIR"]).resolve()
assertions = json.loads(base64.b64decode(os.environ["ASSERTIONS_B64"]).decode("utf-8"))
for assertion in assertions:
    target = (project / assertion["path"]).resolve()
    try:
        target.relative_to(project)
    except ValueError as error:
        raise AssertionError("File assertion escaped the project directory") from error
    exists = target.is_file()
    if exists != assertion["exists"]:
        raise AssertionError(f"Unexpected file existence for {assertion['path']}")
    if not exists:
        continue
    content = target.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    for expected in assertion.get("contains", []):
        expected = expected.replace("__VSCUSE_APP_NAME__", project.name)
        if expected not in content:
            raise AssertionError(f"Expected content is absent from {assertion['path']}")
    for unexpected in assertion.get("notContains", []):
        unexpected = unexpected.replace("__VSCUSE_APP_NAME__", project.name)
        if unexpected in content:
            raise AssertionError(f"Unexpected content is present in {assertion['path']}")
PY
```
